title: Glitter & Grain — Tumblr Moodboard Collage
description: A lo-fi fashion moodboard layering soft-grain photo cutouts at lazy rotations, glittery script captions, and scattered sparkle motifs over a dusty lavender tiled ground — closer to a Tumblr dashboard than a slide deck.
philosophy: This template exists to communicate feeling, not argument. It values accumulation, grain, and emotional texture over legibility hierarchies and whitespace discipline. It refuses straight edges, uniform scale, and any aesthetic that signals professional distance. It is built for fashion researchers, editorial mood rooms, and creative directors who understand that lo-fi is a deliberate stance, not a production shortcut.
goodFor: Fashion mood research presentations to editorial or design teams
Creative concept decks where atmosphere matters more than data
Student thesis mood chapters in art and fashion programs
Brand identity brainstorms anchored in nostalgic or dreamy references
avoidFor: Client-facing corporate pitches requiring clear information hierarchy
Accessibility-critical presentations where contrast and legibility are mandated
Technical product walkthroughs with multi-step diagrams
author: harness

examples.promptCore: Feels like a Tumblr dashboard mid-scroll — grainy photo cutouts accumulate at the periphery while glittery script floats at the emotional center of the slide. Compositional rhythm is dense and layered outward, open and breathing exactly where the title lives. Sparkle motifs scatter freely around the title cluster, never symmetrical, never intentional-feeling. Avoid any implication of grid discipline, deliberate whitespace, or professional distance — every gap should read as happy accident.

examples.layoutNotes: Edge-to-edge bleed on the dusty lavender tiled ground — no outer margins, no framing borders. Photo cutouts at lazy rotations cluster in the upper-left and lower-right quadrants, leaving a rough visual clearing in the center-to-lower-center zone for the title. The title element sits slightly off true-center with a subtle rotation, subtitle nestled just beneath it in close proximity rather than at a measured distance. No header band, no page number, no structural dividers — the slide edge is simply where the collage stops.

examples.promptCore: The slide reads like a Tumblr dashboard mid-scroll — tactile, grain-dusted, emotionally saturated rather than informative. Cutout imagery piles in lazy asymmetric stacks, each piece slightly tilted as if dropped by hand, with glittery script captions drifting over the seams. Sparkle motifs punctuate empty pockets like stickers pressed onto a journal page, uneven and unhurried. Avoid clean alignment or any gesture that signals professional distance — this slide should feel assembled, not designed.

examples.layoutNotes: No strict column grid — elements scatter in a loose, weighted cluster centered slightly left-of-canvas with overflow bleeding toward bottom-right. Photo cutouts layer at staggered lazy rotations, each offset from its neighbor, with overlapping edges creating depth through physical layering logic rather than a uniform z-order. Key text — a quote fragment, a single evocative phrase, or a mood label — sits mid-canvas but tilted, hemmed in by scattered sparkle motifs that fill the negative gaps. Slide identifier appears as a small hand-annotated numeral in the bottom-right corner; no header band, no rule lines.
